acceptanceCriteria: Document all worker/native/control temporary output producers and transitive uncertainties under the safe environment.
Define supported safe root selection or explicit generated-output reservation requirements without weakening environment validation.
Prove actual standalone worker outputs match declared scope, including interruption cleanup; retain version and execution evidence.
body: Confirmed integration friction during V1-0541/#394 on Core rc1 build163, Tasks developer build202. SafeEnvironment fixes TMPDIR=/tmp; caller pinned /private/tmp/corvint-394-parent-tmp does not propagate. Actual N2 native receipt retained config under /tmp/corvint-playwright-*. Producers also include corvint-new-test-output-* and corvint-behavior-control-*. Expected: explicit truthful scope inventory or supported safe per-run temporary root. Actual: reserved parent temp misses inner outputs. Not a proven Tasks scope guard bug. Evidence /private/tmp/corvint-394-parent-proof/inner-tmp-scope-blocker.json; additive scope proposal retained separately. Parent remains open; this ticket owns durable tooling/inventory improvement, not a duplicate of parent strength implementation.

completion.reason: Delivered in beamfall/corvint#760 (https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/pull/760; landed by batch PR #789); on main at 00dd220753973cd7eb332b3b7572db4a2ca60265 (https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/pull/789). Tests named in the PR: corvint-tests-accept --temp-root focused tests. Doc gates, repin check, independent review and dogfood bind/check/seal reported PASS in the PR. make gate NOT_RUN (owner scoped-work preference); native claim unavailable (COVERAGE_UNKNOWN/RESOURCE_COLLISION).
